simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מָשָׁה (H4871) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מָשָׁה (mâshâh) means to pull out (literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: 2Sam 22 17.

definitions.full: H4871. mashah [ מָשָׁה ] verb draw (Arabic cleanse uterus of camel, Aramaic clean, stroke, the face, etc.; מְשָׁא (Talmud) wash the hands; Zinjirli משׂי [ י ] perhaps wash oneself, DHM Sendsch. 60 ); — Qal Perfect suffix מְשִׁיתִהוּ מִןהַֿמַּיִם Exod 2:10 out of the water I drew him (used to explain משֶׁה , but see this below) Hiph`il Imperfect suffix = Qal , figurative רַבִּים מִמַיִם יַמְשֵׁנִי 2Sam 22:17 = Psa 18:7 (subject ׳י ).
